title: The DJ hiding in GTA 6's 80s radio station #shorts
lines: Whose voice is yelling on GTA 6's eighties radio station?
Right after launch, players heard a manic, oddly familiar DJ on Vice City FM.
Rockstar confirmed it to Kotaku. It's Weird Al Yankovic.
He says he also wrote in-game ads and voices the Burger Shot commercials.
In the late seventies, he was a DJ at Cal Poly's campus radio station.
He even recorded his parody My Bologna in a bathroom across the hall.
Now he's back on air, yet his own songs seem nowhere on the playlist.
So next time a DJ screams between songs in Leonida, just ask:
description: That screaming 80s DJ in GTA 6 has a surprising past, and it started at a college radio station. #gta6 #gtavi #weirdal #gaming #shorts
